import sys
input = sys.stdin.read
data = input().split()

index = 0
t = int(data[index])
index += 1
results = []

for _ in range(t):
    n = int(data[index])
    index += 1
    sets = []
    
    for _ in range(n):
        k = int(data[index])
        index += 1
        elements = set(map(int, data[index:index + k]))
        index += k
        sets.append(elements)
    
    found = False
    for i in range(n):
        if found:
            break
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            if len(sets[i] & sets[j]) >= 2:
                results.append(f"{i + 1} {j + 1}")
                found = True
                break
    
    if not found:
        results.append("-1")

print("\n".join(results))
